name: TOPY.AI AI CFO skills
description: AI CFO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: a senior CFO, accountant and bookkeeper on your own Stripe and QuickBooks. Core skills run on the TOPY CFO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/cfo); QuickBooks' bank feed and rules are done in Chrome with the checks in each skill; standalone skills are finance methods that work anywhere.

tiers.core: Runs on the TOPY MCP server; needs a TOPY account.
tiers.connected: Uses TOPY data and actions when the MCP server is connected; works on its own otherwise.
tiers.standalone: A finance method that works with any agent; can save results to TOPY where it fits.

skills.name: Daily CFO brief
skills.summary: The founder's daily money check in five lines — cash in the banks and Stripe, runway, last month's close, the next deadline, anything failed or disputed — silent when nothing changed.

skills.name: Connect the AI CFO
skills.summary: Connects the founder's AI CFO — the TOPY CFO MCP server, Stripe (read-only key), QuickBooks (sign in with Intuit) and the company facts from Companies House.

skills.name: CFO goals
skills.summary: Sets the AI CFO's goals — cash safety, books closed on time, zero late filings, healthy unit economics — as objectives under the CEO's goal tree, so every finance task serves one.

skills.name: First set-up of the books
skills.summary: The first set-up of a small UK company's books with the AI CFO — company facts, share capital as Companies House shows it, Stripe booked month by month, bank transfers paired, suppliers and bank rules — until every bank and Stripe account equals reality.

skills.name: Categorise transactions (UK)
skills.summary: How a UK bookkeeper categorises a small company's transactions — which account, the tax effect, and when to ask — with suppliers created in QuickBooks.

skills.name: Journals and adjustments
skills.summary: Books the journals a bookkeeper needs — accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, corrections — balanced, numbered once and previewed before they reach QuickBooks.

skills.name: Month-end close
skills.summary: Closes a month the way a senior accountant does — Stripe booked and reconciled, bank feed cleared, nothing uncategorised, every bank reconciled to its statement — then management accounts and the c-level reports.

skills.name: Share capital
skills.summary: Keeps share capital as Companies House shows it — shares issued at their nominal value, what each shareholder still owes, and their payments booked against it, not as income.

skills.name: Stripe's official MCP (money moves)
skills.summary: When money must move in Stripe — a refund, a payment link, a subscription change — the CFO drafts it and the founder does it through Stripe's official MCP server or dashboard, never through TOPY's read-only key.

skills.name: Stripe revenue operations
skills.summary: The CFO's watch on Stripe — balance and payouts, the month's sales, refunds and fees, failed payments and disputes — with the chasing handed to the CRO.

skills.name: Stripe into the books
skills.summary: Books Stripe in QuickBooks the way an accountant does — one journal per month (sales by plan, refunds, fees) and one transfer per payout — so the Stripe account always equals Stripe's balance and each payout matches the bank.

skills.name: Match the bank feed (Chrome)
skills.summary: Matches QuickBooks' bank feed in Chrome — Stripe payouts to their transfers, transfers between the company's own accounts paired — acting only where the date and amount match exactly, with every key press checked first.

skills.name: Bank rules (Chrome)
skills.summary: Creates QuickBooks bank rules in Chrome from the CFO's rule list — supplier, account, conditions, auto-post — testing each rule's match count before saving, so recurring transactions post themselves correctly.

skills.name: Lock a closed month
skills.summary: After a close, sets QuickBooks' closing date in Chrome (with the founder's yes) so nobody changes a reported month by accident.

skills.name: Reconcile a bank account
skills.summary: Reconciles each bank account to its statement — record the statement balance, compare it with QuickBooks, find the difference — and, with the founder, completes QuickBooks' own Reconcile in Chrome.

skills.name: QuickBooks reports
skills.summary: Reads QuickBooks' reports — profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, general ledger, aged debtors and creditors — and explains them in plain words with the figures behind them.

skills.name: Finance reports for the c-levels
skills.summary: One-screen finance reports for each AI cofounder — CEO, CMO, CTO, CRO, CPO, COO, CSO — and the board, each with the numbers that role owns, its flags, and the questions the CFO needs that role to answer.

skills.name: Management accounts
skills.summary: The month's management accounts in one page — P&L against last month, cash and runway, balance sheet highlights, KPIs and the CFO's commentary — built from QuickBooks and Stripe after the close.

skills.name: Runway and cash plan
skills.summary: How long the cash lasts, the cash floor, and what to do about it — from real monthly net in QuickBooks and Stripe's pending balance, with three costed options when runway is under 12 months.

skills.name: UK filing deadlines
skills.summary: Every UK company deadline in one list — annual accounts, Corporation Tax payment and CT600 (split when the first period is over 12 months), confirmation statement — from Companies House, with days left and who does it.

skills.name: VAT threshold watch
skills.summary: Watches taxable turnover over the rolling 12 months against the UK VAT registration threshold (£90,000) and warns early, so the company registers on time — or confirms it doesn't need to.

skills.name: Year-end preparation
skills.summary: Gets a financial year ready for the statutory accounts and the CT600 — every month closed, trial balance, year-end adjustments, tax add-backs — as a checklist with figures for the founder or their accountant.
